issues.title: Broken External Symbol Resolution (spec/03)
issues.why: The Go code samples and AC-SC-22 rely on the 'apperror' package and 'AB-NNNN' registry from spec/03, which is not provided in this context.
issues.fix: Provide the normative content of spec/03-error-manage or a mock definition of the apperror package and registry.

issues.title: Inconsistent Database Schema Definitions
issues.why: 01-fundamentals.md defines 'ConfigMeta' and 'Setting' tables, while AC-SC-02/10/15 require 'Configuration', 'Metadata', and 'UserConfiguration' tables.
issues.fix: Realign 01-fundamentals.md SQL blocks to use the table names mandated in the Acceptance Criteria (Metadata/Configuration/UserConfiguration).

issues.title: Ambiguous 'select' Type Mapping in Go
issues.why: AC-SC-14 specifies 'select' maps to 'StringVal', but the Go struct in 01-fundamentals.md still includes legacy 'IntVal' and 'FloatVal' fields.
issues.fix: Update the SettingValue struct in 01-fundamentals.md to match the normative mapping in AC-SC-14 (number -> FloatVal, select -> StringVal).
